Heard learned counsel for the appellants, learned AGA for the State and perused the material placed on record.

Instant criminal appeal under Section 14-A(1) of SC/ST (P.A.) Act, 1989 has been preferred against the entire proceeding of Complaint Case No. 767 of 2020, (Smt. Rubi vs. Ram Varan Singh Yadav @
Bablu and others), under Sections 452, 323, 354, 376/511, 504, 506, 427 IPC and 3(2)(V) of SC/ST Act, Police Station Jaswant Nagar, District Etawah, pending before the learned Special Judge,
SC/ST (P.A.) Act, Court No.2, Etawah and summoning order dated 26.7.2021 as well as bailable warrant dated 30.9.2022.

sentences.text:
By the impugned order, learned court below has summoned the opposite party Ram Varan Yadav @
Bablu, Manjesh, Pankaj and Santosh, who are appellants before this Court to face the trial for charges mentioned as above.

Learned counsel for the appellants submitted that the aforesaid complaint case has been lodged by the complainant/respondent as a counter blast to the case Crime No.14 of 2019, under Sections 147,

1 148, 149, 452, 307, 504, 506 IPC, Police Station Jaswant Nagar, District Etawah, lodged at the instance of appellant No. 1 Ram Varan against husband of the complainant Mahtab Singh and others, in which the husband of the complainant and his associates were arrested on the spot on 14.1.2019 and was sent to jail.

sentences.text: In that incident, Pawan- nephew of appellant No.1 had received gunshot injury and the police submitted the chargesheet after investigation of that case regarding which Sessions Trial No.368 of 2021 is proceeding against husband of the complainant and four others and after registration of the case lodged at the instance of appellant No.1, the complainant Rubi lodged an FIR against appellant No.1, his brother and nephew, which was registered as Case Crime No.81 of 2019, under Sections 395, 397, 354(kha) IPC, in which police investigated the matter and submitted final report and concluded that the said FIR was lodged by the informant only with intention to save her husband, who is accused in a case lodged by Ram Varan Yadav against her husband and others.

Another FIR as Case Crime No.20 of 2019, under sections 147, 148, 149, 452,
307, 504, 506 IPC, Police Station Jaswant Nagar, District Etawah was registered at the instance of one Ramna Devi, wife of Shyam Pal, against appellant No.1 and another.

entities.text: Police Station Jaswant Nagar, District Etawah
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text: Said Ramna Devi is wife of Shyam Pal, who is co-accused in a case lodged by the appellant No.1.
A final report has also been submitted in Case Crime No.20 of 2019 by the police.

After submission of final report, the complainant Smt. Rubi has filed present complaint case against appellant and his family members as counterblast with a view to exert pressure on informant and witnesses to enter into compromise in the case lodged by the appellant No.1.
This is material fact that previous two cases lodged at the instance of complainant and her side were not substantiated during investigation and final report was filed by the police.
The instant case is of no injury case, in which no injury has been found on the person of complainant or witnesses.
The summoning order is non speaking order and is not sustainable in the eyes of law and the same has been passed without application of judicial mind.
Therefore, it is prayed that this Court may please to quash the entire proceeding of the said complaint case in the interest of justice.

Per contra, learned counsel for the private respondent submitted that the incident of present complaint case is entirely different than that of other three police cases and due to the only fact the police has submitted final report in two police cases lodged against present appellants and their family members, it cannot be inferred that the present complaint case is false and concocted and proceedings of the court below cannot be quashed at the threshold.
While passing the impugned summoning order, the court below is supposed to go through the statement of complainant under Section 200 Cr.P.C. and witnesses under Section 202 Cr.P.C..
The court is not supposed to take notice of the material, which are not filed alongwith the complaint.

Learned trial court has summoned the appellants to face the trial on finding a prima facie case emerging from the contents of the complainant statement as well as her witnesses and documents filed in support of her averments in complaint.
From the perusal of impugned order, it cannot be inferred that no case is made out against the appellants to summon them to face trial in said sections, even, if the case is of no injury.

Therefore, I do not find any irregularity, illegality or mis-appreciation of the evidence on record on the part of the learned court below in passing the impugned summoning order and the appeal is liable to be dismissed.
Accordingly, the present criminal appeal is dismissed.
